title: Malicious code in @mamans2973/maman (npm)
description: The npm package @mamans2973/maman versions 1.0.0 through 1.0.3 contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise may allow an attacker to gain full control over the system, necessitating immediate rotation of all secrets and keys from a different, uncompromised machine. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software introduced by it.
